text: Due to the approval of a new, sizeable condominium development at 3100 Keele Street, at the corner of Maryport Avenue, and with a pedestrian/cycling connection to Downsview Park on the east side of Keele Street, it would be beneficial to investigate the possibility of relocating the traffic control signals from Diana Drive to Maryport Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Requested the Acting Director, Transportation Services, North York District, to investigate the feasibility of relocating the traffic signals on Keele Street at Diana Drive to Keele Street at Maryport Avenue and report back to North York Community Council in February 2019.
